set.body:
Scope: mvpa-spatial remnants; optional mvpa4s neurosurf4s/neuroatlas4s integrations.

Deliverable: Finish generic surface/atlas measurement and scatter adapters over the extracted libraries. Keep fMRI threshold/response/fit policy in ScalaFIM. Core MVPA remains independent of all imaging and atlas providers.

Acceptance:
- Standalone optional adapters preserve region/vertex/parcel identity, ordering, masking and scatter results on JVM/JS.
- Volume/surface/atlas measurement scenarios share the same MVPA evidence contracts without reimplementing domains or neighborhoods.
- Neither neuroatlas4s nor neurosurf4s depends on mvpa4s/ScalaFIM; removed adapter copies have no remaining callers.

Apply the shared migration and verification requirements in eco-unification.
set.title: U6: Compose optional MVPA surface and atlas measurements
